surfaces.enforcementPoint: The selected permission package's Pi tool_call policy hook.
surfaces.mechanism: tool policy; runtime state must be obtained from an audited ExecutionStateDriver
surfaces.stateSource: future live doctor probe; the M1 catalog itself reports no active runtime state
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Report the exact degraded state and refuse automatic mutation or policy widening.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Return unavailable or restart-required for modes that require a hard tool-call ceiling.

surfaces.enforcementPoint: The replacement Bash subprocess launched by the selected permission package.
surfaces.mechanism: conditional OS sandbox for that Bash subprocess only
surfaces.stateSource: future permission runtime probe including platform, worktree, and no-sandbox conditions
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Show Bash isolation as degraded without implying file, Web, MCP, Provider, or extension isolation.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Reject operations whose declared safety requires an active Bash sandbox.

surfaces.enforcementPoint: The selected permission package's file-tool path policy.
surfaces.mechanism: tool policy scoped to supported Pi file tools
surfaces.stateSource: future live doctor probe of the selected permission owner
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Report unsupported tools and paths and refuse workflows that require a complete file ceiling.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Do not infer file isolation from Bash sandbox or prompt instructions.

surfaces.enforcementPoint: The explicitly selected web package and its reviewed request policy.
surfaces.mechanism: allowlist configuration; M1 does not assert that a live allowlist is active
surfaces.stateSource: future live doctor package capability and allowlist probe
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Disable research Web capability when an independent allowlist cannot be demonstrated.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Deny Web-dependent modes; browser cookies remain disabled.

surfaces.enforcementPoint: The single selected MCP bridge and per-server tool allowlist.
surfaces.mechanism: reviewed server and tool allowlist; no MCP package is promoted by M1
surfaces.stateSource: future mcp doctor metadata probe without credential reads
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Keep MCP disabled when server identity or tool policy cannot be verified.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Deny MCP-dependent modes and do not discover host configuration automatically.

surfaces.mechanism: unknown to only-my-pi at M1; no second Provider client is introduced
surfaces.stateSource: future non-secret Pi runtime metadata only
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Report unknown rather than deriving Provider isolation from another surface.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Reject profiles or modes that require a Provider egress guarantee not supplied by Pi or outer isolation.

surfaces.enforcementPoint: The Pi process or an outer container that hosts arbitrary extension code.
surfaces.mechanism: outer sandbox only; Project Trust and extension filtering are not process isolation
surfaces.stateSource: future outer-runtime probe; package selection alone is not enforcement evidence
surfaces.degradedBehavior: Report unknown or degraded per extension and do not summarize the whole session as isolated.
surfaces.failureBehavior: Reject untrusted extension workloads that require hard egress isolation when no outer boundary is active.
